name: vsql_bindcheck_test
description: Coverage fixture for the typed bind_and_check_types API (BindArgs/BindResult). TAG is a custom type parameterized by a 'label'; tag_make(label, n) derives the return type's label from a constant argument value, and tag_relabel(tag, label) derives it from both an argument's resolved parameters and a constant.
